Priya: Heads-up  new partner announce sprint: GateFlow + NorthStar SI + NimbleCompute + LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. Target week May 12-16. Who takes checklist?
Sam: I can own greenroom + demo. Need stable script by Thu.
Lena: Legal needs logos, MSA countersign, and PR-blurb by Fri COB.
Jordan: Marketplace ops  AWS prefers May 13, GCP May 15; need SKUs + AMI/Helm links 2 business days prior.
Mei: I'll coord partner quotes and approvals.
Alex: Tech: pin adapter versions in assets. LangChain v0.8 OK; LlamaIndex needs note about prefix schema. I'll run canary Thurs am (200 queries) and post p95/p99.
Sam: Greenroom checklist: deploy command, demo dataset, smoke tests (latency/cost), partner on-call. Alex paste deploy snippet pls.
Alex: deploy_demo.sh --env=greenroom --model=redwood-llama-7b-q4 --adapter=gateflow-1.3; then curl smoke POST. Use partner-scoped key.
Priya: Talking points: unified orchestration Hosted/Dedicated, SI integration playbook, HW perf gains, LangChain/LlamaIndex support, reliability fallback policy.
Lena: Embargo set to 2025-05-12 10:00 PT. Partners must ACK.
announce-bot: Reminder set  greenroom 2025-05-11 09:00 PT; announce 2025-05-12 10:00 PT.
Priya: Owners recap  Greenroom: Sam; Legal: Lena; Marketplace: Jordan; Partner comms: Mei; Tech tests: Alex. Post blockers here.
